effect.x-y: Pokémon on the user’s side of the field are immune to stat-lowering effects for five turns. Guard Swap, Heart Swap, and Power Swap may still be used. Defog used by an opponent will end this effect.

short_effect.x-y: Protects the user’s stats from being changed by enemy moves.
short_effect.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Protects the user’s stats from being changed by enemy moves.

flavor_text.x-y: The user cloaks itself and its allies in a white mist that prevents any of their stats from being lowered for five turns.
